title: FactWriteRequest
description: Payload a microservice POSTs to {mycelium}/api/things/{thingId}/properties/{property}/facts to assert a structural Fact (the synchronous, never-lossy write kind). Shape derived from vos.Service.Shared.MyceliumClientBase.SetFactAsync and Mycelium's FactWriteDto.

value.description: The asserted property value: any JSON scalar (string, number, boolean) or null.
